prompt:
A full-bleed 9:16 vertical retro educational survival field-guide illustration with subtle ink wash, rendered on sun-bleached cream parchment with fine sand grain, salt-stained tide mottling, and abraded driftwood-worn edges framing the central window.

The composition depicts an unpopulated desert-island survival site in the wake of a tropical gale. In the midground, a fragile lean-to shelter built of lashed driftwood poles and woven palm fronds lies fractured and torn open, its dried thatch ripped apart and strewn across the ground. Snapped branches, tangled cordage, and wind-blown storm debris litter the churned, sun-bleached sand. In stark contrast to the ruined structure, an intact survival cache sits immediately beside the wreckage: tightly sealed clay jars, hollowed gourd water vessels, and bundled dried rations remain untouched, undamaged, and securely anchored. In the background, wind-sheared coastal palms lean against a churning sea-glass teal surf beneath a heavy, storm-slate gray horizon.

Artistic Style: Weathered field-guide linework with crisp, slightly broken dark-brown ink contours, delicate crosshatching, and soft translucent ink-wash shadows. A restrained palette of faded parchment cream, bleached dune sand, weathered timber and dry palm browns, muted sea-glass teal, washed sky blue, storm-slate gray, and subtle rust-orange accents on frayed ties. Glaring tropical daylight softened by aged paper texture, offset by dark overcast coastal clouds.

Compositional Rules: Strictly host-free and uninhabited; absolutely no human figures, characters, silhouettes, faces, or hands. No reserved lower caption banner, blank strip, or artificial void; the illustrated landscape naturally fills the full vertical height. No text, lettering, numbers, field labels, diagrams, UI, swatches, or sheet borders. NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: a recurring salt-weathered survival-field-guide page: irregular sun-faded parchment edges, subtle tide-line staining, sand abrasion and driftwood-colored edge wear surrounding a clean central illustration window; the same aged coastal material frame persists across every body image without changing medium. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI. Binding isolation: no recurring host, no selected host, and no foreground person or character.
